# CanvasGroup

- Inherits [`Frame`](frame.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("CanvasGroup")`

A `Frame` whose descendants are drawn together and then shown as one picture (ADR 0128): a window that fades as a whole, instead of its parts fading through each other. `GroupTransparency` and `GroupColor` apply to the picture.

The picture is redrawn only when something inside it changes, and it clips: nothing inside a group is drawn outside its box.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GroupColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | A colour the whole picture is multiplied by. White changes nothing. |
| `GroupTransparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How see-through the group is, as one: 0 is solid and 1 is not drawn. |
